itemized.notes: Handwritten all-caps form, Joe Hatch, year-end (form's own header boxes are blank - no page numbers, no candidate name, no date of report - so the page order is taken from the PDF). The Complete Mailing Address column is EMPTY on every Schedule A row, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout; Occupation/Employer is filled on six rows and is recorded in those rows' notes since the row contract has no field for it. Most whole-dollar amounts are written with a trailing dash (500 - / 1000 -), read as .00 per the currency convention and noted per row. HONEST NON-SCOPE INSIDE A SIDE: three Schedule B rows on p5 (75.00, 75.00, 100.00) have an EMPTY Name of Recipient cell; in place of three payees the filer wrote one braced note across those rows - 'INFORMATION REQUESTED FROM BANK / WHEN RECIEVED REPORT WILL BE AMENDED'. Those rows are emitted with vendor_raw='' and needs_review=1, never a guessed payee; the braced text is carried in purpose and explained in the note. One p4 date is a RANGE ('1/08 - 1/09', Wells Fargo bank charges) and one p4 day is overwritten past legibility; both dates are blank with needs_review=1. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: date/name/amount counts agree row-for-row on all three pages (15, 14, 7), the six occupation annotations sit on the six individual contributors and not on the LLCs and unions around them, and every page gates exactly on its own printed subtotal. No shift found.
